What explains this discrepancy in the reported revenue figures?"}, {"cites": ["S8.u02"], "kind": "management_view_or_forecast", "text": "The company states it intends to file an appeal regarding the 46.3 crore rupee GST demand. What is the expected timeline and outcome of this legal process?"}], "snapshot": [{"cites": ["S3.u01"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Sarvottam Cables Ltd is a manufacturer of power cables, wires and conductors."}, {"cites": ["S3.u02", "S3.u03", "S3.u04"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "For Q1 FY27, the company reported revenue of 1,248 crore rupees, EBITDA of 140 crore rupees, and an EBITDA margin of 11.2%."}, {"cites": ["S3.u05"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Profit after tax for Q1 FY27 was 82 crore rupees, a 5.9% increase from the previous year."}, {"cites": ["S2.u02"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "As of June 2026, 4.1% of the promoter holding was pledged, down from 11.5% in June 2025."}]}
